models.M1_ARTIFACT_ONLY: Direct comparison of cryptographic serialized outputs without framing or protocol headers.

M2_KEY_EXCHANGE.Scenario_K1: Initiator already possesses recipient's verified public key. Initiator transmits ephemeral key/ciphertext.
M2_KEY_EXCHANGE.Scenario_K2: Full two-way ephemeral key exchange. Excludes certificate chain and TLS record headers.

M3_SIGNED_MESSAGE.Option_A: Public key cached at receiver (only payload, signature, and optional framing transmitted).
M3_SIGNED_MESSAGE.Option_B: Public key transmitted alongside signature (self-contained signed object, e.g. JWT or detached signature envelope).

critical_distinctions: X25519 produces a 32-byte public key; ML-KEM-768 produces a 1184-byte public key and 1088-byte ciphertext.
X25519 shared secret is computed mutually via scalar multiplication, not transmitted as ciphertext.
ECDSA DER signature length is mathematically variable (69-73 bytes); ML-DSA-65 signature is strictly fixed (3309 bytes).
Models represent application-layer serialization and do not substitute for full TLS/TCP/IP packetization.
